title: piper hispidum f. lanceolatum
intro: Piper hispidum f. lanceolatum, commonly known as a type of pepper plant, is a species of flowering plant in the Piperaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Piper hispidum f. lanceolatum include pain relief, fever reduction, and digestive aid, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as alkaloids and flavonoids. These constituents also contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions, including respiratory issues and skin infections.
